classification_rule: ZERO_SALES first for zero total units and undefined CV. For positive total units, X has CV <= 0.5; Y has 0.5 < CV <= 1; Z has CV > 1. Class boundaries use exact integer weekly moments: N=12*sum(x*x)-sum(x)^2 and D=sum(x)^2; X if 4*N<=D, else Y if N<=D, else Z. Display rounding and floating tolerance do not determine membership.
display_normalization: Thousands separators are omitted. sku_count is a JSON integer; units and zero_sales_product_weeks are decimal-integer strings. Percentages retain four decimal places and median CV six decimal places as strings. ZERO_SALES median_cv remains JSON null. Padding trailing zeros preserves displayed numeric values.
